limitations: These are generative multi-view references, so minor breech, connector, ring, reflection, and grip-groove details are not mathematically identical; use left.png as the canonical reconstruction authority.
Front and rear views intentionally collapse the two lengthwise grips onto one vertical silhouette; the side views define their actual longitudinal placement.
Background alpha was reconstructed from a neutral baked background. All final files have verified alpha=0 corners, but very bright neutral glass highlights may carry reduced alpha.
The final 3D asset will require a true transparent/refraction material and adequate wall thickness; geometry generation alone may otherwise appear opaque.
scope_stop: Concept/reference generation only. No Meshy, Tripo, Blender, or Unity work performed.
